title: HLElevators
body:
# HLElevators

Simple one-block elevators for Minecraft 1.7.10 (Forge)
### How it works

Place two or more elevator blocks vertically, stand on the bottom one and jump to go up. Sneak (Shift) to go down. The space above the destination block must be clear (two air blocks).
### Configuration

**File**: config/hle.cfg
